observations: Front-load washing machine, silver/grey body, LG logo visible on upper left of panel (photo 0).
Text on panel reads 'Inverter DirectDrive 6/3kg' and a red badge reads 'Washer+Dryer 2 in 1' (photo 0).
Control panel display shows lit digits '00' and the selector dial has an illuminated orange ring, indicating the unit has power reaching the electronics (photo 0).
Drum door is closed; some reddish/pink fabric visible inside drum through glass (photo 0).
Unit sits on a small pedestal/base; a loose white cable is visible hanging beside it (photo 0).
No rating plate, serial number, or full model code (e.g. WD-xxxx) is legible in the photo.
Floor and wall around the unit show water staining and peeling paint, consistent with a laundry area, not diagnostic of the machine's internal condition.

claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap, doesn't work, needs repair
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the control panel display lit ('00') and the dial ring illuminated orange, indicating the unit currently receives power and has active electronics, which is inconsistent with a fully dead 'scrap' unit, though it may still fail to wash/spin.

risks.risk: Drum motor, belt, or bearings may be seized or damaged, preventing wash/spin cycles despite powered electronics.
risks.proof: A video clip of the seller pressing start and showing drum rotation or hearing the motor attempt to run.

risks.risk: Water inlet/drain pump or hoses may be missing, corroded, or leaking, common in units sold as 'scrap'.
risks.proof: Photos of the rear panel, hose connections, and pump filter area.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing full hose/pump replacement

risks.risk: Internal control board or heating element condition unknown; display lighting does not confirm full board health.
risks.proof: Photo or video of a full diagnostic cycle start-up showing no error codes.
risks.if_unproven: priced as board/heater unverified, worst case faulty

risks.risk: Missing accessories (door seal integrity, detergent drawer, power plug) not fully visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of door seal, detergent drawer, and plug end of power cable.

risks.risk: Unknown whether item is sold as whole machine or just the drum/shell for parts ('scrap' wording ambiguous).
risks.proof: Seller confirmation photo showing all major components present (motor, drum, control board) and whether sold as complete unit.

proof_requests: Video of seller attempting to power on and start a wash cycle (does drum move, does it fill/drain water).
Close-up photo of the rating/serial plate (usually inside the door rim or on the rear) for exact model number.
Photos of the rear panel, hoses, and pump filter.
Confirmation whether all parts (motor, drum, control board) are present and intact.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an LG front-load washer-dryer combo, but the seller's 'doesn't work' claim is only partly consistent with the photo (display/dial lit), and no functional test or internal evidence is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-working scrap unit pending proof.
